_comment.1: OPEN-LOOP capture for contrib/com_survey: one minute of raw ROI frames, same camera configuration as steering_par_fsp_wfs_com.json, with NO tracker, NO fsp and NO DAC in the pipeline. Nothing is actuated, so whatever the beam does here is the beam, not a loop.
_comment.2: Run it with the FSM parked at its normal bias, exactly as contrib/probe_frame.json expects. Let the coarse channels settle (~30 s) before starting, or the drift during settling will show up as beam motion.
_comment.3: Writes com_survey.aylp: 40-byte header per frame (magic u32, version/status/type/units u8 at 4..7, log_dim.y/x u64 at 8/16, pitch.y/x double at 24/32), then height*width uint8. At 32x32 and fs~3788 one minute is ~227k frames and ~236 MB. Check you have the disk space.
_comment.4: count = 60 s * 3788 fps. If your achieved fs differs, scale it -- the analyser reads the real frame count from the file and only needs --fs to convert to Hz.
_comment.5: Then: ./build/com_survey com_survey.aylp --fs 3788   (add --row-time once you have measured it; it does not affect the recommendation).

pipeline._comment: Live view while it captures; decimated so it cannot back-pressure the loop.
